campaigns={'d42fae6c-ba17-450f-8efd-6f7edc1070e9': ['b1fb3fce-018a-471f-8de3-c8f2104d0d34', 'f085ebd0-a857-493d-8ea2-a5dc6899f3fd', 'aa4a5223-5c3d-4f26-9faf-b0ec521b1cfd'], 'db4481d8-feda-4c69-afa7-957f0b8a271b': ['2a354c59-8590-4098-a426-f3859ab04862', 'c0696baf-400c-41c4-ae9c-33f4d2cf27c3', '0778b7c4-4952-47aa-8f7b-9d387ac54e7b'], 'aae926a6-78bd-4fd0-b52a-3abe5bdb8f95': ['666f8af0-ade0-4dd0-ae30-01c91657782a', 'aea8e897-74f7-4db2-a2db-df1918a1d659', 'ce694f60-d73d-4a21-bb95-66d092c6d86b']}

import hashlib,json,socket,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
assert socket.gethostname()=='infra-serverless';root=Path('/srv/p2enjoy-serverless');sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'e2e'))
from control_database import read_control
D=['runuser','-u','spark-docker','--','docker','--host','unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock']
physical=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['python3','-B',str(root/'e2e/storage-console-inspect.py'),json.dumps(campaigns)],text=True))
assert physical['completed']
ids=[v for values in campaigns.values() for v in values];marks=','.join('?' for _ in ids)
with read_control(root/'state/control.sqlite3') as db:
 firings=[dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM schedule_firings WHERE function_id IN ('+marks+') ORDER BY window_at,id',ids)]
 assert all(r['state']=='succeeded' and r['completed_at'] is not None for r in firings)
 invocations=[dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT id,function_id,trigger,schedule_firing_id,schedule_origin,schedule_expression,schedule_slot,state,handler_started,requested_code_hash,resolved_code_hash,logs FROM invocations WHERE function_id IN ('+marks+') ORDER BY id',ids)]
 assert len(firings)==len(invocations)
 for firing in firings:
  invocation=next(v for v in invocations if v['id']==firing['invocation_id'])
  assert invocation['state']=='succeeded' and invocation['trigger']=='schedule' and invocation['schedule_firing_id']==firing['id'] and invocation['resolved_code_hash']==firing['code_hash']
  witness=json.loads(invocation['logs'].strip());assert witness['marker']=='scheduled-original-A' and witness['body']=={} and witness['trigger']=='schedule' and not witness['platform_token_present'] and not witness['authorization_present']
 assert not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM schedule_generations WHERE function_id IN ('+marks+') AND retired_at IS NULL',ids).fetchone()
 assert not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM schedule_firings WHERE completed_at IS NULL').fetchone()
 assert not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM functions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL').fetchone()
 versions=[v[0] for v in db.execute('SELECT version FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version')]
 global_counts={name:db.execute(sql).fetchone()[0] for name,sql in {'instances':'SELECT count(*) FROM execution_instances','operations':'SELECT count(*) FROM function_operations','reserved_bytes':'SELECT coalesce(sum(reserved_bytes),0) FROM deployments','active_calls':"SELECT count(*) FROM invocations WHERE state IN ('receiving','queued','admitted','running')"}.items()};assert not any(global_counts.values())
services=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(D+['inspect','serverless-api','serverless-runtime-reference'],text=True))
assert all(v['State']['Health']['Status']=='healthy' for v in services)
source="""import hashlib,json;from pathlib import Path;r=Path('/app');print(json.dumps({'backend':{str(p.relative_to(r)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [*r.joinpath('app').glob('*.py'),*r.joinpath('migrations').glob('*.sql'),r/'function_code_hash.py']},'web':{str(p.relative_to(r/'web')):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (r/'web').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}}))"""
embedded=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(D+['exec','serverless-api','python','-B','-c',source],text=True))
artifacts={str(p.relative_to(root/'state/artifacts')):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted((root/'state/artifacts').rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
original={'files':len(artifacts),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(artifacts,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}
assert original=={'files':5982,'manifest_sha256':'846904e1437a034d7fd95488f246cd5b3dc935a4723d20abf9bb419673e5d482'}
print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'original_artifacts':original,'global_counts':global_counts,'physical':physical,'firings':firings,'invocations':invocations,'migrations':versions,'services':[{'id':v['Id'],'image':v['Image'],'started_at':v['State']['StartedAt']} for v in services],'embedded':embedded,'official_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ['/etc/spark/env','/run/spark/secrets','/etc/spark/routes']}}))

capture_observation: 21 JPEG observés individuellement ; desktop et history-desktop de même cadrage, sans identité de fichiers, listes prolongées par défilement ; aucune preuve de pagination >5 tirs ni des états vide/erreur/longs.
limitations: Promotions successives, retour de hash, retrait/désactivation/suppression autour de fenêtres restent à qualifier.
SIGKILL avant/après réclamation, arrêt multi-fenêtres et absence de rattrapage restent à qualifier.
Recouvrement long, saturation et stockage exclusif occupé restent à qualifier.
Grammaire complète (listes, plages, pas, dimanche, OU jour/semaine), rétention et états UI complémentaires restent à qualifier.
Le garde de rétention des invocations sources est corrigé mais sa fenêtre de panne temporelle reste non éprouvée.
Régression complète de plateforme non exécutée ; nouvelles migrations à prendre en compte dans les clients de cette campagne.
Noms de mois/jours hors grammaire numérique suivis dans SLS-098 ; payloads de jobs dans SLS-081.
